segments.title: How much time is MISSING from these rocks?
segments.say: How much time is missing from rocks like the Grand Canyon's? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Up to a BILLION years!
segments.sub: **200 million** to over a billion, by place
segments.say: Up to a billion years! From two hundred million, depending on the place.

segments.title: The Great Unconformity
segments.sub: Young rock sits on **far older** granite
segments.say: Geologists call it the Great Unconformity: young rock sitting right on far older granite.

segments.title: New idea: the deep Earth
segments.sub: A model, not proven · **Nature**, Univ. of Wollongong
segments.say: A new model says slow currents deep inside Earth lifted the land, so it wore away. An idea, not proof yet.
